header.label: projects
header.title: Routing an Unexploded Device at Minimum Expected Damage
header.lede: Moving a device that may detonate across a built-up area, along the route that minimizes expected damage to the surrounding buildings, with a handful of expensive blast simulations instead of thousands.
header.access: ↓ The animation below is a preview: click it to open the interactive demo.

rows: Python, NumPy/SciPy, scikit-learn, mpi4py, SLURM, PyVista

decisions.title: What "safest" means
decisions.formula: \mathbb{E}[D(\gamma)] = \int_0^L \lambda e^{-\lambda s}\, S(\gamma(s))\,ds = \lambda \int_0^L S(\gamma(s))\,ds + R,\qquad |R| \le \tfrac12 \lambda^2 L^2 \max S
decisions.caption: S(x): criticality-weighted damage if the device detonates at x. First order in λL ≪ 1.

decisions.title: Learn the correction, not the field
decisions.formula: r(x) = f_{\text{ARMEN}}(x) - f_{\text{KB}}(x),\quad r \sim \mathcal{GP}(0, k),\quad \mu_{\text{post}}(x) = f_{\text{KB}}(x) + \bar r(x)
decisions.caption: k: Matérn 5/2 kernel in 2D, hyperparameters by maximum marginal likelihood.

decisions.title: Simulate where the route is uncertain
decisions.caption: Since sd(Σ f(c)) ≤ Σ σ(c), this bounds the relative standard deviation of the corridor's total danger from above: the rule is conservative.

decisions.title: An exact search that sees turns
decisions.formula: h(v) = w_{\min}\,\lVert v_{xy} - B_{xy}\rVert_2,\qquad C(u,v) \ge h(u) - h(v) \;\Rightarrow\; \text{A* optimal on } 22\,500 \text{ states}
